predecessors.name: Russian Empire
predecessors.text: the land west of the Ural where 'Russia let Sultan Bukey, son of Nur Ali, settle permanently' in 1801 with some 7,500 families of the Junior Zhuz

successors.name: Russian Empire
successors.text: the area 'gradually came under Russian civil administration' after the khan's office was abolished in 1845

ledger.x: 1801: Sultan Bukey settles with 7,500 families west of the Ural.

certainty.note: A nomad pasture grant with no surveyed border; the page gives an area but no frontier.
